turns.content: How do I add a section view through the lobby?
Simply click on the Section tool, then click two points across the lobby to draw the section line. That's it!

¿Cómo cambio las unidades del proyecto a métricas?
Go to Manage > Project Units and set Length to millimeters or meters. The change applies to all views.
Undo whatever you did to the roof.
I undid the change to the roof, so it's back the way it was.
Why is my render taking forever?
Your render is set to Best quality at 600 DPI with 212 lights on. For drafts, try Medium quality at 300 DPI and turn off lights you don't need in this view.
